zh.text: 從 2007 年 6 月至 2021 年 6 月推出回測，JOJO.Index 回報 548.45%。高收益：106.35%。長期國債：150.56%。推出後實盤：-7.23%。高收益：+18.84%。相同規則，完全不同時代。利率上升改變了防禦性部分的計算。

en.text: Backtested from June 2007 to the June 2021 launch, the JOJO.Index returned 548.45%. High yield: 106.35%. Long Treasuries: 150.56%. Live since launch: -7.23%. High yield: +18.84%. Same rules, very different era. Rising rates changed the math for the defensive sleeve.

zh.text: Steve Hanke關於#TurkeyWatch：伊斯坦布爾官方年度零售通脹10月為32.47%/年。今天，他測量土耳其通脹為22.31%/年。由於他的測量領先官方數字，他預計官方數字將下降。通脹仍是埃爾多安的致命弱點。

en.text: Steve Hanke on #TurkeyWatch: Istanbul’s official annual retail inflation came in at 32.47%/yr in October. Today, he measures Turkey’s inflation at 22.31%/yr. Since his measure leads the official one, he expects the official number to fall. Inflation is still Erdoğan’s Achilles heel.

zh.text: Mark Cuban 回覆每個人都應努力追求那個目標，但詢問失業者應如何處理工作及支付帳單。

en.text: Mark Cuban replies that everyone should strive for that, but asks what an unemployed person should do about a job and paying their bills.

zh.text: 沙特阿拉伯經濟第三季度同比萎縮3.8%，為連續第二次收縮。石油活動暴跌20.4%。特朗普對伊朗的選擇性戰爭正在使王國沉沒。

en.text: Saudi Arabia’s economy shrank 3.8% y/y in Q3, its second straight contraction. Oil activity plunged 20.4%. Trump’s war of choice on Iran is sinking the kingdom.

zh.text: Gary Black 指出美國股市週一盤前反彈（標普 +0.5%，納指 +0.9%），此前因 AI 拋售及 $GOOGL/$INTC 業績令人失望，受布倫特原油下跌 4.1% 幫助。科技股回升（$NVDA +1.3%，$GOOG +1.5%，$AMZN +1.0%，$SKHY +4.6%，$MU +2.4%），10 年期收益率降至 4.91%。本週重點包括 $AAPL 業績、中期選舉（Kalshi 預測民主黨橫掃機率 71%）、週五就業報告。標普 2026 年 EPS 估計 369 美元（同比 +33%）暗示 20.5 倍市盈率。因估值偏高、未來盈利下修及自動駕駛競爭加劇，對 $TSLA 保持謹慎。AI 支出承諾超過 3 萬億美元，多家科技公司發行新債券。

en.text: Gary Black notes U.S. stocks rebounded pre-market Monday (SPX +0.5%, NDX +0.9%) after AI selloff and disappointing $GOOGL/$INTC results, aided by Brent crude -4.1%. Tech recovered ($NVDA +1.3%, $GOOG +1.5%, $AMZN +1.0%, $SKHY +4.6%, $MU +2.4%), 10-year yield fell to 4.91%. Key events: $AAPL earnings, midterms (Kalshi 71% odds Democratic sweep), Friday jobs report. S&P 2026 EPS $369 (+33% YoY) imply 20.5x P/E. Cautious on $TSLA due to stretched valuation, negative revisions, autonomous competition. AI spending commitments exceed $3T with new bond offerings.

zh.text: 不。德國的TARGET2債權基本上是高債務外圍國家人為債息上限及貨幣大幅高估的對應物。這無法輕算消。若沒有這些債權，外圍貨幣已經大幅貶值，當然它們有一天仍可能這樣做…

en.text: No. Germany’s TARGET2 claims are basically the counterpart to artificial yield caps and big currency overvaluations on the high-debt periphery. There is no netting this out. Without these claims, periphery currencies would have devalued massively and of course they still might one day…

zh.text: ADNOC首席執行官Sultan Al Jaber關於飆升的石油運費成本的影響：能源安全不僅在生產點衡量，現在也在交付點衡量。

en.text: ADNOC CEO Sultan Al Jaber on the impact of surging oil freight costs: energy security is not only measured at the point of production. It is now also measured at the point of delivery.

zh.text: 在荷蘭，僱主必須繼續支付病假員工728天工資，近兩年，而盧森堡只有77天，差距651天。這使荷蘭公司處於巨大的競爭劣勢。

en.text: In the Netherlands, employers must continue paying sick employees for 728 days, nearly two years, compared to 77 days in Luxembourg, a gap of 651 days. This puts Dutch companies at a significant competitive disadvantage.

zh.text: Base的Jesse Pollak表示，加密主流採用意味著迄今為止世界上少於1%的美元和股票在鏈上，產品市場契合度和增長明顯但尚未推高持倉。他預計隨著大型金融公司為更快更便宜的服務而採用，份額將在未來5-10年內從不足1%上升到10%、50%、90%。

en.text: Base's Jesse Pollak says crypto mainstream adoption means less than 1% of the world's dollars and equities are onchain so far, with clear product-market fit and growth but not yet pumping bags. He expects the share to rise from under 1% to 10%, 50%, 90% over the next 5-10 years as major financial companies adopt for faster, cheaper services.
